title: Xuanzang departs Chang'an
shortSummary: Around 629, Xuanzang's journey connected Chang'an with pilgrimage networks across the Hexi Corridor, Central Asia and South Asia.
curatorialDescription: Departure begins the route evidence; it does not give every point on later maps equal certainty.
researchNote: Month of departure, permission narratives and the first route segment require comparison across sources.
